title: AirBlockFromGhast
description: Allows you to build in the air while standing on the Happy Ghast.
body:
_Hello, everyone. First of all, I strongly recommend that you download projects through the official curseforge and modrinth launchers—this will increase the reward for the creators. Thank you all very much for your support!!!_

[![chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7ba56bdea313f30d12390daaabdd4d5e3893385.webp)](https://discord.gg/s8vZR4PGr2) 

**If you climb to a height, crouch down, and right-click (with a block that can be placed) in your hand on Happy Gast, this block will be placed under Happy Ghast, allowing you to create a platform.**

[![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be430e7f950991c85de23828c5efe38f082a33c8.webp)](https://ko-fi.com/iyouroverlord!)
